main_text.l: pro singulari more Attico: Thucydides, ἔδοξεν αὐτοῖς
πρεσβεία ἐς τοὺς Λακεδαιμονίους εἶ[?], visum est ipsis acceden-
dum ad Lacedæmonios esse. Idem, ὅτι δ' αὐτὸ ἔφερεν ἡ γνώμη, ἀδικεῖν τοὺς
Ἀθηναίους, ᾗ πολεμητέα εἶ[?], eòdem tendebant sententiæ, injurios esse Athe-
entiam habet, quæ Latinis varié ex-
ἀγνοῶν, manifestus es ignorans, pro manifesté
ignoras. Idem, δῆλός ἐστιν ἀχθόμενος, pa-
lam ægré fert. Phalar. παῦσαί δὲ ἡ σαυτῷ ἢ ἐμοὶ πραγμάτια
παρέχων, define autem & tibi ipsi & mihi negotia ex-
tans, id est, me ægrotare. Demosth.

page.notes: The Greek is printed small and some words are uncertain; those marked [?] are doubtful readings. The catchword "σαυτῷ" is printed at the lower right, below the last line.
